SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO, COUNT(LEGACY_PO_SEQ) LEGACY_COUNT FROM V_KEP_PO WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY LEGACY_PO_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HUNG' AS BUYER, 'KM' AS SITE, PLANT , STATUS , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BUYER_ITEM_NO , CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_QTY , ITEM_AMT , ADD_DATE , RD_DATE , DELY_TO_LOCATION , PURCHASER_USER_ID , LEGACY_PR_NO||'-'||LEGACY_PR_SEQ AS LEGACY_PR_NO , LEGACY_PR_SEQ , REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , REQ_USER_TEL AS REQ_USER_INFO , REMARK , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , 'N' AS LEGACY_END_YN, '$G_RS.LEGACY_COUNT$' AS LEGACY_COUNT FROM V_KEP_PO WHERE LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE V_KEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', SEND_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), SEND_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
